content:
**Peacetime Radio** is an unused radio station in *Fallout 76*.

There are only two remaining mentions of its existence in the game files, a quest node with the editor ID ClassicalMusic_PeacetimeRadio as well as a keyword function named SQ_RadioPeacetime_Start. The former indicates that Peacetime Radio may have served a similar function to Classical Radio, which appears in the game.
